entries.title: Psalms 101:1
segments:
Mercy and judgment; God's mercy and judgment in exalting David's family to the throne in the place of Saul's.  The psalmist then proceeds to show how he will execute his high office. 
 
They whom God has exalted to high stations, should ascribe to him the praise of all their influence and opportunities to do good.

entries.title: Psalms 101:2
segments:
Come unto me; as my helper in the discharge of my duties.  He is conscious that he cannot execute his good intentions without God's aid. 
 
Pious rulers will endeavor, both in the family and in public life, to set a holy example which may be safely and usefully followed by all.

entries.title: Psalms 101:6
segments:
The faithful of the land; men who are trustworthy, and can be relied on to do their duty. 
 
  Dwell with me; as my servants. 
 
Righteous magistrates will choose only the good and faithful for their conucillors and helpers.

entries.title: Psalms 101:8
segments:
Early; literally, morning by morning, that is, with promptness and vigilance. 
 
It is the aim of every good ruler to favor righteousness and put down iniquity.
